svg.title: MK-677's longer placebo-controlled trials in adults
svg.desc: MK-677's longer placebo-controlled trials in adults. Older adults, 2 years (2008), 65 people: Lean mass up; no strength gain. Obese men, 8 weeks (1998), 24 people: Lean mass up; fat same; glucose worse. Hip fracture, 6 months (2004), 161 people: IGF-1 up; no significant functional gain. Hip fracture, phase 2b (2011), 123 people: Stopped early: heart failure signal. Osteoporosis, 18 months (2001), 292 people: Bone density gain at one site only. Alzheimer's disease, 12 months (2008), 563 people: No slowing of decline.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1228 people in six trials. IGF-1 rose in every one; the outcomes people care about mostly did not move.
